newsitem.title: THAILAND: Tanayong Thai skytrain ready at end-1999.
newsitem.headline: Tanayong Thai skytrain ready at end-1999.

text.p: Bangkok's skytrain system, to be built by Tanayong Plc subsidiary Bangkok Mass Transit System Ltd (BTS), will be operational by December 1999 and not earlier, a senior BTS executive said on Wednesday.
Reacting to a remark by BTS chairman Kasame Chatikavanij that the system could be finished within 30 months, BTS senior vice-president Howard Brooke said it would take longer.

"I think the chairman was being a little optimistic. On October 2, we signed a deal with our contractors to complete the project within 38 months. That will take us up to the last month of the millennium, which is a cosy, feasible date," he told reporters.
